stableDecisions.menu: Web menu in Bulgarian and English; do not reintroduce a visible PDF-menu feature unless explicitly requested.

tasteJourney.mainArticle: The main focaccia article remains unchanged.
tasteJourney.landingOrder: Main focaccia story first, followed by product stories in a single vertical sequence.
tasteJourney.articleFocus: The product leads every product article; producer and region provide context.
tasteJourney.subtitlePattern: Use product-appropriate variants of the agreed format, e.g. “Произведена в Марке от Sabelli”.
tasteJourney.mapPosition: The Italy map is at the bottom of the Journey of Taste landing page.
tasteJourney.mapBehaviour: The simple Italy silhouette is decorative; explicit labelled region buttons filter the product stories. Do not add guessed geographic hotspots.
tasteJourney.marketShareRule: Show market share only when a reliable exact claim is supported. Do not mention missing market-share data.
tasteJourney.mapStyle: Use one clean owner-supplied Italy outline and explicit labelled region buttons. No numbers, blobs, guessed hotspots or decorative region shapes.

stableDecisions.typography: Use responsive clamp-based sizes, do not split words, and avoid isolated letters or syllables. Home hero lines use the same size.
stableDecisions.homeHero: Use one cohesive photographic hero scene. The two equal-size headline lines must remain fully visible and must never overlap the image. Do not show development commentary below the image.
stableDecisions.socialControls: Facebook, Instagram and TikTok stay grouped on the left; the larger Google review button stays separately on the right.
stableDecisions.homeCards: Both the three dark quick-fact cards and the four light feature cards are full-card links with keyboard focus states and direct destinations.
stableDecisions.googleRating: Use Google Business Profile Reviews API with OAuth. Never show a fixed or approximate review count when live data is unavailable.
stableDecisions.salumeria: The menu contains a bilingual Salumeria section before drinks. Prices are displayed in EUR only; most items are priced per 100 g, while fresh Burrata is 125 g.
stableDecisions.croissant: The freshly baked croissant is served with Corsini espresso or cappuccino and is available plain or filled with chocolate, pistachio cream or apricot.
stableDecisions.beerPhotography: Birra Moretti, Peroni and Peroni Nastro Azzurro use owner-supplied bottle images in dedicated beer cards.
stableDecisions.openingHours: Use Google Business Profile openInfo.status, regularHours and specialHours. CLOSED_TEMPORARILY overrides schedules and must never produce an inferred reopening date. If live data is unavailable, link to Google instead of claiming a local open/closed state.

socialLinks.layout: Social networks on the left; Google review on the right.

menuUpdate.winePresentation: Separate cards for wine by the glass and controlled bottle cards.
